# Metaplate v0.1.1

Metaplate 0.1.1 is a focused safety and CI reliability patch for the initial release, removing a pathological path-normalization case and stabilizing cold native rendering on Windows runners.

> **Upgrade recommendation:** Recommended for all 0.1.0 users, particularly services that accept route/image path input and projects that verify native PNG rendering on Windows CI.

## Why upgrade

The original slash-trimming expressions could take polynomial time on maliciously long input. Although ordinary route strings are small, public metadata helpers should not make input length an algorithmic risk. The patch replaces that behavior with linear-time trimming and also gives cold native PNG initialization sufficient room on slower Windows runners.

## Highlights

### Linear-time path handling

- Route and image-path slash trimming no longer relies on the pathological regular-expression shape.
- Processing time now scales linearly with input length.
- Normal route and image URL output remains unchanged.

### More reliable Windows verification

- Cold Resvg/native PNG startup is allowed enough time on Windows CI.
- The adjustment targets initialization variance without weakening image assertions.
- Linux and normal warm rendering behavior is unchanged.

## Breaking changes

None. This patch preserves the 0.1.0 public API and output format.

## Install or upgrade

```sh
npm install metaplate@0.1.1
```

No configuration or migration is required after upgrading from 0.1.0.

## Verification

- Long path inputs exercise the linear-time normalization path.
- Existing metadata URL expectations remain unchanged.
- Windows CI covers cold native PNG initialization with the corrected timing allowance.
